Sweat. Vegetables in oil 8 min; add tomato paste, 2 min; paprika off the heat.
Simmer. Add beans, water and bay; simmer 30 min until creamy; crush a few beans to thicken.
Finish. Savory and fresh mint; season. Remove bay.
6033122c.st: Blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

fbc4662c.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Blanch. Cover the chicken legs with cold water, bring to the boil, drain and rinse.
Broth. Cover with the cold water, add the halved onion, bay leaf and peppercorns; simmer at 85–90 °C for 60 min, skimming. Chicken ≥ 75 °C core.
Meat. Strain the broth; pick the meat, discard skin and bones, dice 1 cm.
Barley. Rinse the barley and cook in the broth 30 min. Add carrots, celery, leek and potatoes (1 cm dice); simmer 15–20 min.
Finish. Return the chicken, season with the salt. Bring to the boil; ≥ 75 °C core.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C in a soup kettle, max 2 h; parsley per batch; portion 250 g. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
fbc4662c.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat to boiling.

5a313f42.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Poach. Chicken breasts in stock at 80–85 °C, 15–18 min, to 74 °C core. Dice 1 cm; keep the stock.
Prep. Onion and carrots 1 cm dice; potatoes 2 cm; parsley chopped.
Sweat. Butter, onion and carrot 8 min without colour. Add potatoes and strained stock; simmer 15–20 min.
Blend. Blend smooth, pass through a chinois.
Thicken. Add cream, simmer; whisk in slaked corn starch, cook 2 min to nappe. Add chicken; season.
Hold. ≥ 75 °C core, then ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; parsley on top. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
5a313f42.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

61dd1b6a.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Dice onion, carrots and potatoes 1 cm; keep potatoes in cold water. Chop parsley.
Poach. Bring chicken stock to 90–95 °C; poach breasts 18–22 min to 74 °C core. Lift out, shred along the grain.
Vegetables. Simmer onion and carrots 5 min; add potatoes, simmer 10 min until just tender. Skim.
Season. Return chicken; add salt and pepper, then lemon juice off the boil. Stir parsley into each batch.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; replace with a fresh batch. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reboil before service.
61dd1b6a.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

c: Yield: finished chicken soup with vegetables & rice
Broth. Cover chicken thighs with cold water, bring to a simmer, skim and cook 40 min; core ≥ 75 °C.
Shred. Remove chicken, cool slightly and shred; strain the broth.
Vegetables. Sweat diced onion, leek, carrot and celery in olive oil 5 min; add broth and simmer 10 min.
Rice. Add washed rice and cook 15 min until tender.
Finish. Return chicken, season, finish with chopped parsley. Hold at min. 63 °C.
5225b0bb.st: Blast-chill to below 5 °C within 90 min; 3 days at 0–4 °C. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C.

c8a27898.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Cut broccoli into small florets; peel and slice stalks 5 mm. Dice onion 1 cm, potatoes 1.5 cm.
Sweat. Sweat onion in butter 5–6 min, no colour. Add potatoes and hot stock; simmer 10–12 min until soft.
Broccoli. Add stalks, then florets after 2 min; boil uncovered 5–6 min until just tender.
Blend. Blend immediately until velvety; pass through a medium chinois.
Finish. Add cream, return to a bare simmer; season with salt and pepper. Adjust with stock to coat a spoon.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; stir every 15 min. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat to boiling.
c8a27898.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

c: Sweat onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil and butter, 10 min, without colour.
Add tomato paste, fry 2 min; add tomatoes, stock, sugar and basil stalks; simmer 25 min.
Blend smooth, add cream, bring back to the boil; season.
Bread without crust in 1.5 cm cubes; toss with oil and salt.
Bake at 170 °C, 10–12 min, until golden and dry.
Soup ≥ 75 °C into 3 hot tureens ≈ 1200 g; a few drops of olive oil and basil leaves on top.
Croutons in 3 small bowls next to each tureen; soup plates on the table.
e042f0d1.st: Soup: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Croutons: airtight, room temperature, 3 days.
e042f0d1.al: 1 Gluten (white bread) · 7 Milk (cream 20%, butter) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock, celery stalk). Vegetable stock: check label (celery).

34b7b868.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Blanch. Cover the lamb neck with cold water, bring to the boil, drain and rinse – keeps the broth clear.
Broth. Cover with the cold water, bring slowly to a simmer and skim; add the halved onion, bay leaf and peppercorns. Simmer at 85–90 °C for 2 h.
Meat. Strain the broth; pick the meat off the bones and dice 1 cm. Discard bones, onion and bay.
Barley. Rinse the barley and cook in the broth 30 min. Add carrots, celery, leek and potatoes (1 cm dice); simmer 15–20 min until tender.
Finish. Return the meat, season with the salt. Bring to the boil; ≥ 75 °C core.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C in a soup kettle, max 2 h; parsley and dill per batch; portion 250 g. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
34b7b868.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat to boiling.

84914f29.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Lentils. Pick over and rinse; cover with the listed cold water, bring to the boil, skim.
Vegetables. Onion, carrots and peppers 1 cm dice; sweat in oil 8 min, no colour; add garlic 1 min.
Spice. Off the heat stir in paprika (no burning); add to the lentils with the tomatoes.
Simmer. Bare simmer 35–40 min until lentils are soft; add savory, salt and pepper in the last 10 min.
Finish. Adjust thickness with hot water; check seasoning; chopped parsley on top.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; refill from the kettle. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
84914f29.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

aa9bbb29.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 265 g = 2650 g · Portion: 265 g
c: Lentils. Pick over and rinse; cover with the listed cold water, bring to the boil, skim.
Vegetables. Onion, carrots and peppers 1 cm dice; sweat in oil 8 min, no colour; add garlic 1 min.
Spice. Off the heat stir in paprika (no burning); add to the lentils with the tomatoes.
Simmer. Bare simmer 35–40 min until lentils are soft; add savory, salt and pepper in the last 10 min.
Finish. Adjust thickness with hot water; check seasoning; chopped parsley on top.
Croutons. Bread without crust 1.5 cm cubes with olive oil; dry heat 170 °C, 10–12 min until golden; cool.
Hold. Soup ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; refill from the kettle. Croutons in a bowl beside.
aa9bbb29.st: Soup: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Croutons: airtight, 3 days.

c981ec5d.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Onion, carrots, celery 8 mm dice; potatoes and zucchini 10 mm; slice garlic thin. Rinse beans. Heat stock.
Soffritto. Sweat onion, carrot and celery in olive oil 8–10 min without colour; garlic for the last 2 min.
Simmer. Add chopped tomatoes 3–4 min, then potatoes, hot stock and salt; boil, skim, simmer 10 min.
Pasta. Add zucchini, beans and ditalini; simmer 8 min, stirring, until al dente. Adjust salt and consistency with stock.
Finish. Tear basil in off the heat; keep a few leaves for garnish.
Hold. Soup kettle ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h, then discard. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat once ≥ 75 °C.
c981ec5d.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

b3b8d468.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Pumpkin 2 cm dice; onion and carrots sliced 5 mm. Bring vegetable stock to a simmer.
Sweat. Sweat onion and carrot in butter, medium heat, 5 min without colour.
Simmer. Add pumpkin and three-quarters of the hot stock, salt lightly; cover, simmer 20–25 min until soft.
Blend. Purée with a stick blender until smooth; pass through a fine chinois.
Finish. Add cream, return to a simmer; season with salt and nutmeg; adjust to light nappe with remaining stock.
Hold. Soup kettle ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h, portion 250 ml. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat to boiling.
b3b8d468.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

ea923c0a.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Sweet potato and carrots 2 cm dice; onion sliced; garlic and ginger grated.
Sweat. Sweat onion, garlic and ginger in the oil at ≈ 140 °C for 5 min, no colour.
Simmer. Add sweet potato, carrots, water and chilli; simmer covered 20–25 min until soft.
Blend. Add the coconut milk; blend smooth with a stick blender. Adjust to 2500 g with hot water if needed.
Finish. Season with the salt and lime juice. Bring to the boil; ≥ 75 °C.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C in a soup kettle, max 2 h; chopped coriander per batch; portion 250 g. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
ea923c0a.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat to boiling, whisk well.

4579d28d.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Meatballs. Mix minces, rice, grated onion, savory, salt and pepper; roll 12 g balls, dust in flour.
Base. Sweat onion, carrot, celery and pepper in oil 5 min; add water, potatoes and rice; simmer 10 min.
Poach. Add meatballs one by one, simmer 20 min; add diced tomato last 5 min.
Liaison. Whisk yoghurt and eggs; temper with 1 l hot broth, stir back off the heat. Do not boil.
Finish. Season, parsley. Core ≥ 75 °C before liaison.
4579d28d.st: Blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat gently to ≥ 75 °C (do not boil after the liaison).
4579d28d.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%) · 9 Celery (celery stalk)

675ab231.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Onion, carrot, celery 8 mm dice; potatoes 1 cm; green beans 1.5 cm; tomatoes peeled, 1 cm dice.
Sweat. Sweat onion, carrot and celery in oil 6–8 min without colour.
Simmer. Add hot stock and potatoes; boil, skim, simmer 8 min.
Rice. Add rinsed rice; simmer 12 min, stirring occasionally.
Finish. Add beans and tomatoes; simmer 6–8 min until just tender. Season. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; parsley on top. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; loosen with stock when reheating.
675ab231.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to boiling.

53aadbdc.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 240 g = 2400 g · Portion: 240 g
c: Marinate. Boneless thighs with soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, five-spice and salt; 4–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast. Skin-side up on a rack over a GN tray at 190 °C convection 22–25 min to ≥ 75 °C core; brush with the marinade (boiled 1 min) in the last 5 min.
Cabbage. Shred the cabbage 2 cm, carrots julienne. Stir-fry in the hot oil with garlic and ginger 3–4 min, still crisp; add soy sauce, sesame oil and salt.
Service. Cabbage in a GN 1/1, chicken sliced or whole on top, sesame seeds and sliced spring onion over. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
53aadbdc.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
53aadbdc.al: 1 Gluten (wheat in soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil, seeds)

06eea8a4.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 255 g = 2550 g · Portion: 255 g
c: Prep. Portion the fish into 10 × 140 g; season with salt, pepper and orange zest, brush with oil. Lay on lined GN trays.
Sauce. Simmer orange juice, grated ginger and honey 5 min; thicken with cornflour slaked in cold water; stir in the oil, season, strain. Yield 350 g.
Cauliflower. Toss florets with oil and salt; roast at 210 °C convection 15–18 min until golden at the edges; parsley.
Service. Cauliflower in a GN 1/1, fish on top, sauce spooned over. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h.
06eea8a4.st: Raw fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Cooked fish and cauliflower: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min, 0–4 °C, 48 h. Sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h.

e3e858b6.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 140 g = 1400 g · Portion: 140 g
c: Prep. Check fillets for pin bones; portion 140 g raw.
Season. Oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, paprika, salt and pepper; 10 min before baking.
Bake. One layer on oiled GN 1/1, combi 180 °C, 30 % humidity, 8–10 min to 63 °C core, just flaking.
Herb oil. Blend chopped parsley with olive oil; cut lemons into wedges.
Hold. GN 1/2, herb oil over each fillet, lemon wedges; ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h. Bake in batches of 25.
e3e858b6.st: Cook in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 24 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C. Check fillets for pin bones.

c3b487c7.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 260 g = 2600 g · Portion: 260 g
c: Marinate. Rub the lamb with oil, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, salt and pepper; 12 h at 0–4 °C. Roll and tie.
Roast. Sear on all sides, then roast at 160 °C combi (30 % humidity) to ≥ 75 °C core (≈ 90–100 min). Rest 15 min, slice 1 cm.

Jus. Brown onion, carrot and celery in the roasting tray; add paste 2 min; deglaze with wine and reduce by half. Add stock and rosemary, simmer 20 min, strain, reduce to 300 g; thicken lightly with cornflour slaked in cold water. Season.
Pumpkin. 3 cm dice, toss with oil, rosemary and salt; roast at 200 °C convection 20–25 min until golden.

Service. Pumpkin in a GN 1/1, lamb slices on top, jus over. Garnish variants: replace the pumpkin with 100 g ratatouille or caponata (house cards) – then check the garnish allergens. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
c3b487c7.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
c3b487c7.al: 9 Celery (celery stalk, beef stock – check label) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

0b0e1f87.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 290 g = 2900 g · Portion: 290 g
c: Marinate. Rub the pork with mustard, garlic, oil, salt, pepper and thyme; 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast. Roast whole at 160 °C combi (30 % humidity) to ≥ 75 °C core (≈ 100 min). Rest 10 min, slice 1 cm.
Juices. Deglaze the roasting tray with the hot water and strain – this is the base for the sauce.
Cabbage. Shred 5 mm. Sweat onion in butter, add cabbage, caraway, salt and sugar; braise covered 25–30 min; finish with vinegar.
Sauce. Sweat onion in butter, add pepper and flour (roux 2 min), whisk in the roasting juices then the cream; simmer 10 min. Stir in the mustard off the boil.
Service. Cabbage base in a GN 1/1, overlapping pork slices, sauce nappé or in a boat. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
0b0e1f87.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.

795914a8.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 160 g = 1600 g · Portion: 160 g
c: Prep. Remove pin bones, trim belly, portion 140 g; keep at 0–4 °C.
Season. 10 min before cooking, season with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.
Bake. Skin down on oiled GN 1/1; combi 180 °C, 30 % humidity, 8–12 min to 60–63 °C core, just opaque.
Butter. Melt butter gently with grated garlic, no colour; off the heat add lemon juice and chopped dill. Keep at about 60 °C.
Serve. Cook in batches of 10–12 every 15–20 min. One layer in GN 1/2, skin down, 20 g butter over each.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core.
795914a8.st: Cook in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 24 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.

c: Reduce wine with chopped shallots to ⅓; add cream, reduce by half.
Off the boil, whisk in cold diced butter little by little; add lemon juice, salt and chopped dill.
Hold at 60–65 °C in a bain-marie, do not boil.
Pin-bone fillets, cut 15 pieces × 110 g, skin on; keep at 0–2 °C.
Season, brush with oil, lay skin-down on a lined tray with lemon slices.
3 warm platters, 5 pieces each, roasted lemon and dill; sauce in 3 sauce boats.
18e3606f.st: Cook for the sitting, do not hold more than 30 min. Raw fillet: 0–2 °C, 24 h.
18e3606f.al: 4 Fish (salmon trout fillet) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 20%) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

3bf70144.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 155 g = 1550 g · Portion: 155 g
c: Prep. Remove pin bones, trim belly, portion 140 g; keep at 0–4 °C.
Season. 10 min before cooking, season with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.
Bake. Skin down on oiled GN 1/1; combi 180 °C, 30 % humidity, 8–12 min to 60–63 °C core, just opaque.
Dressing. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, grated garlic and chopped dill; no dairy.
Serve. Cook in batches of 10–12 every 15–20 min. One layer in GN 1/2, skin down, 15 g dressing over each.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core.
3bf70144.st: Cook in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 24 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.

d47c9e3f.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Fish 250–300 g; rinse cavity, remove blood line, pat dry. Score skin twice per side, 3 mm deep.
Fill. Mix chopped parsley and garlic with a little oil and lemon. Season fish, fill cavities.
Bake. Oiled GN 1/1, head to tail, skin brushed with oil; combi 200 °C, 20 % humidity, 14–18 min.
Core. ≥ 63 °C behind the head; flesh opaque, lifts from the bone.
Finish. Drizzle with remaining lemon and pan juices; adjust salt.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h, garnished with parsley; replace with a freshly baked tray every 30 min.
d47c9e3f.st: Cook in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 24 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.

e6f406b4.yl: Yield: 10 portions (2 clay pots × 5) · Portion: 400 g
c: Pork and beef in 5 cm pieces; chicken legs split at the joint. Season with salt.
Brown in oil in batches on high heat, 5–6 min; do not crowd the pan.
Sausage in 3 cm pieces, not browned.
Squeeze sauerkraut lightly, chop coarsely. Rinse rice.
Mix sauerkraut, diced onion, rice, paprika, pepper, allspice and savory.
In each pot layer ⅓ of the sauerkraut mix, half of the meats, rest of the mix; bay leaves on top.
Pour wine and hot water, ≈ 325 g per pot, just below the top layer.
Seal with lid and foil; bake at 150 °C, 3½–4 h, until meat is tender and rice cooked.
Uncover for the last 15 min at 180 °C for a light crust; core ≥ 75 °C.
Serve 400 g per portion with mixed meats and sausage; or the whole pot at the table.
e6f406b4.st: Browned meats: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Cooked kapama: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat covered at 160 °C to ≥ 75 °C core.
e6f406b4.al: 14 Sulphites (red wine). Banski sausage: check label (6, 7, 10 may be present).

7d679b2b.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 230 g = 2300 g · Portion: 230 g
c: Sear. Brown the beef in batches in hot oil; remove.
Onions. Cook the onions slowly in the same pan until golden, 20 min – this is the body of the goulash.
Paprika. Add garlic and caraway; off the heat stir in both paprikas (burnt paprika turns bitter), then tomato paste and flour for 2 min.
Braise. Return the beef, add hot stock and bay leaf; simmer covered 1.5–2 h (or 150 °C oven) until tender.
Finish. Add pepper strips for the last 25 min, marjoram at the end; remove bay, season. ≥ 75 °C core.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; loosen with hot stock if it tightens. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
7d679b2b.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
7d679b2b.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 9 Celery (beef stock – check label)

9579da26.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 200 g = 2000 g · Portion: 200 g
c: Prep. Beef chuck 2.5 cm cubes, trimmed; season just before searing. Onion in strips, peppers 2 cm, mushrooms quartered.
Sear. Brown beef in hot oil in single-layer batches, 4–5 min. Remove.
Base. Sauté onion and peppers 6 min; add garlic, paprika and savory off the heat, 30 s. Deglaze with wine, reduce by half.
Braise. Add beef, tomatoes, stock and bay leaf; cover, bare simmer (or combi 160 °C) 75–90 min until tender.
Finish. Sauté mushrooms separately until golden; fold in last 10 min. Remove bay; season. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; parsley on top. Dairy-free (Sat): no butter. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
9579da26.st: Leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.

5b0f1bab.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 150 g = 1500 g · Portion: 150 g
c: Mix. Keep minces ≤ 2 °C. Dissolve baking soda in the ice-cold water; add with salt, pepper and ground cumin.
Knead. Paddle on low speed 4–5 min until sticky; keep mix below 8 °C.
Mature. Cover and rest overnight at 0–4 °C.
Shape. With wet gloved hands or a press, shape 45 g cylinders, 10 cm long, \~2 cm thick. Chill.
Grill. Oiled chargrill or plancha \~230 °C, 8–10 min, quarter-turn every 2 min, to ≥ 75 °C core. For volume, finish in combi 180 °C.
Hold. Portion 3 pieces (120 g) with 30 g lyutenitsa. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
5b0f1bab.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

271f4a4a.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 255 g = 2550 g · Portion: 255 g
c: Panade. Mix breadcrumbs, beaten eggs and finely grated, squeezed onion; rest 5 min.
Mix. Combine mince (0–2 °C) with panade, chopped parsley, toasted ground spices (cumin), salt and pepper until just sticky.
Shape. Roll 35 g balls onto lined GN 1/1; chill 20 min.
Bake. Combi 200 °C dry, 12 min until browned.
Sauce. Sweat 5 mm diced onion, carrots, celery with garlic in olive oil 8 min; add passata, sugar; simmer 20 min, blend, salt.
Simmer. Combine meatballs and sauce, simmer gently 10 min to ≥ 75 °C core; fold in torn basil.
Beans. Blanch in boiling salted water 3–4 min, refresh in iced water; per batch toss in foaming butter with sliced garlic 2 min.
Hold. Meatballs in sauce GN 1/2 and beans GN 1/2 side by side, ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h (beans 1 h).
271f4a4a.st: Meatballs in sauce: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C core. Beans: finish in batches for service.

54a1bf6d.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Meatballs. Soak breadcrumbs in the water 5 min. Add mince, onion, eggs, garlic, parsley and spices; knead 2 min until tacky. Fry a test ball and adjust.
Shape and bake. Shape 35 g balls (4 per portion). Bake at 200 °C convection 12–15 min to ≥ 75 °C core.
Eggplant. 2.5 cm dice, toss with oil and salt; roast at 210 °C convection 20–25 min until golden and soft.
BBQ sauce. Sweat onion and garlic in the oil, add paprika, then the remaining ingredients; simmer 20 min, blend and reduce to 400 g (coating consistency).
Service. Eggplant in a GN 1/1, meatballs on top, glazed with half the sauce; rest of the sauce in a boat. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
54a1bf6d.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
54a1bf6d.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs · 10 Mustard (Dijon). Ketchup: check label.

cf087f6d.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 180 g = 1800 g · Portion: 180 g
c: Panade. Mix breadcrumbs, beaten eggs and finely grated, squeezed onion; rest 5 min.
Mix. Combine mince (0–2 °C) with panade, chopped parsley, toasted ground cumin, salt and pepper until just sticky.
Shape. Roll 35 g balls onto lined GN 1/1; chill 20 min.
Bake. Combi 200 °C dry, 12 min until browned.
Sauce. Sweat 5 mm diced onion, carrots, celery with garlic in olive oil 8 min; add passata, sugar; simmer 20 min, blend, salt.
Simmer. Combine meatballs and sauce, simmer gently 10 min to ≥ 75 °C core; fold in torn basil.
Hold. GN 1/2 ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; replenish by half GN. Portion meatballs 110 g, sauce 70 g.
cf087f6d.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

dde7014b.yl: Yield: 77 plates · Portion: ≈ 460 g (steak 250 g raw / ≈ 200 g cooked · risotto 180 g · caponata 80 g)
c: Batch · 77 × 250 g raw · Yield ≈ 15400 g cooked
Portion rib-eye in 250 g steaks, 2.5 cm thick; temper 30 min out of the fridge; salt and pepper.

Butter. Soften butter; fold in chopped capers, lemon juice and parsley; roll and chill.
Grill. Hot grill or plancha 2 min per side for marks; finish combi 160 °C, 5–6 min.
Core. 52–55 °C for moist flesh (≥ 63 °C if required); rest 2 min.
Finish. Slice of caper butter on each steak; lemon wedges.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 30 min per batch; grill in waves.
d65f370a.st: Cook in batches for service; caper butter 0–4 °C, 5 days. Leftover fish blast-chill, 24 h, cold use only.

5c83ddce.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 170 g = 1700 g · Portion: 170 g
c: Prep. Pin-bone hake, portion 110 g, hold 0–2 °C. Dice onion 3 mm, slice garlic finely, olives 3 mm.
Sauce. Sweat onion and garlic in olive oil 6–8 min; add tomatoes, sugar, salt; simmer 20 min until thick. Add olives, parsley.
Season fish. Salt, pepper and lemon juice just before cooking, max 10 min.
Assemble. 1 cm hot sauce in oiled GN 1/1; fish skin-side down on top, drizzle olive oil.
Bake. Combi 160 °C, 50 % humidity, 10–12 min to ≥ 63 °C core; flesh opaque and flaking. Cook in half-GN batches.
Hold. GN 1/2 with parsley, ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Portion fish 110 g, sauce 60 g. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C.
5c83ddce.st: Cook in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 24 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.

8ee26cf7.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 230 g = 2300 g · Portion: 230 g
c: Prep. Portion the cod into 10 × 140 g; season with salt and pepper, brush with oil; lay on lined GN trays.
Crust. Blitz breadcrumbs with herbs, garlic, zest and salt; add the oil until it holds when pressed. Press 25 g on top of each portion.
Bake. 190 °C convection 10–12 min until the crust is golden, ≥ 63 °C core.
Tomato. Halve the tomatoes, top with garlic, thyme, sugar, salt and oil; roast at 180 °C convection 25–30 min until soft and lightly caramelised.
Service. Tomatoes in a GN 1/1, cod on top. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h.
8ee26cf7.st: Raw fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Herb crust: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Cooked fish: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min, 0–4 °C, 48 h. Roasted tomatoes: 0–4 °C, 72 h.

6a15f2b2.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Meatballs. Soak breadcrumbs in the water; mix with all meatball ingredients, knead 2 min. Test-fry and adjust.
Shape and bake. Shape 33 g balls (4 per portion); bake at 200 °C convection 12–14 min to ≥ 75 °C core.
Vegetables. 1.5 cm dice; roast eggplant, zucchini and peppers separately at 210 °C with part of the oil, so each keeps shape and texture.
Tomato base. Onion and garlic in the remaining oil, tomato paste, tomatoes and sugar; simmer 20 min.
Finish. Fold in the roasted vegetables, thyme and basil; season.
Service. Ratatouille in a GN 1/1, meatballs on top. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
6a15f2b2.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.

cc6fd6a1.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 200 g = 2000 g · Portion: 200 g
c: Prep. Lamb shoulder 3 cm pieces, trimmed; season just before searing. Onion and carrots 1.5 cm; potatoes 2.5 cm.
Sear. Brown lamb in hot oil in single-layer batches, 4–5 min. Remove.
Base. Sauté onion and carrots 5 min; add paprika and cumin off the heat, 30 s.
Braise. Add tomatoes, stock, lamb and bay leaf; cover, bare simmer (or combi 160 °C) 60 min.
Finish. Add potatoes, 25 min until fork-tender; peas last 5 min. Remove bay; season. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; parsley on top; 100 g lamb + 100 g vegetables. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
cc6fd6a1.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

c4bf7b53.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 160 g = 1600 g · Portion: 160 g
c: Marinate. Boneless thighs with oil, lemon juice and zest, garlic, chopped thyme and rosemary, salt and pepper; 4–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast. Skin-side up in a GN tray with the sliced onion underneath, 200 °C convection 22–25 min to ≥ 75 °C core.

Jus. Lift out the chicken. Add the water, garlic and thyme to the tray, scrape the base, simmer 5 min; strain, skim the fat, reduce to 300 g. Thicken lightly with cornflour slaked in cold water; add lemon juice, season.
Service. Chicken in a GN 1/1, jus spooned over, chopped parsley. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
c4bf7b53.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.

85f10ce7.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 200 g = 2000 g · Portion: 200 g
c: Season. Drumsticks with salt, paprika, crushed garlic and pepper; 2–12 h at 0–4 °C.
Pre-cook. Combi steam 90 °C, 25–30 min to 75 °C core. Blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
Crumb. Dry the drumsticks; flour, beaten egg, then panko, pressing well. Chill on trays until frying.
Fry. Deep-fry at 175 °C in batches of 20, 3–4 min until deep golden; core ≥ 75 °C. Drain on racks.
Hold. One layer on racks in GN 1/1, uncovered, ≥ 63 °C, max 30 min; fry in batches through service.
85f10ce7.st: Pre-cooked drumsticks 0–4 °C, 48 h. Fry in batches for service; do not keep fried pieces.

14b6ff06.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 250 g = 2500 g · Portion: 250 g
c: Prep. Cut the fish into 10 × 120 g pieces, pat dry, season with salt, pepper and zest.
Crumb. Flour → egg → panko, press well. Keep at 0–4 °C.
Fry. Deep-fry at 175 °C 3–4 min to golden, ≥ 63 °C core. Drain on a rack (not paper – stays crisp). Fry in batches every 15–20 min.
Carrots. Batons; glacer à blanc – water, butter, sugar and salt, covered until tender; uncover and reduce to a glossy glaze. Parsley.
Tartare. Fine-dice gherkins, capers and shallot; fold into the mayonnaise with herbs, lemon and mustard. Keep ≤ 5 °C.
Service. Carrots in a GN 1/1, fish on top; tartare in a chilled bowl. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h for crispness.
14b6ff06.st: Crumbed raw fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Tartare sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Carrots: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min, 0–4 °C, 72 h. Fried fish: do not store.
14b6ff06.al: 1 Gluten (flour, panko) · 3 Eggs (egg wash, mayonnaise) · 4 Fish · 7 Milk (butter) · 10 Mustard (Dijon). Mayonnaise, gherkins, capers: check label.

8cb6e59c.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 210 g = 2100 g · Portion: 210 g
c: Piri piri. Char the red pepper and chillies under the grill, peel and seed (gloves); blend with garlic, paprika, oregano, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Marinate. Coat the boneless thighs with two thirds of the piri piri; 4–12 h at 0–4 °C. Keep the rest for basting.
Roast. Skin-side up at 200 °C convection 22–25 min to ≥ 75 °C core; baste with the remaining piri piri in the last 5 min, finish under the salamander for char.
Peppers. Peppers 3 cm strips, onion in wedges; toss with oil and salt; roast at 210 °C convection 18–20 min.
Service. Peppers in a GN 1/1, chicken on top. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
8cb6e59c.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.

c: Gratin. Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter; layer 2 mm potato slices and mushrooms in buttered GN, cover with garlic cream-milk. 160 °C combi, 60–70 min until tender; set 20 min, cut 150 g portions.
Sauce. Sweat diced onion in butter, deglaze with wine, reduce by 2/3; add stock, reduce by half; add cream, simmer to nappe, whisk in mustard. Season.
Pork. Chops 2.5 cm, season, sear 2 min each side in a hot pan; finish 180 °C, 6–8 min to 66 °C core; rest 5 min (≥ 68 °C).
Spinach. To order, wilt in foaming butter with garlic 30–40 s; season, drain.

Gluten-free (2 pax). Dish is gluten-free as written; check the stock label. Dairy-free (2 pax): pork with oil-roasted potatoes, spinach in olive oil, sauce = wine, stock and mustard reduction, no cream.
Plating. Warm plate: gratin portion centre-left, spinach beside it, chop leaning on the gratin, 50 g sauce at the side of the meat.
ae39aa90.st: Gratin: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min, 48 h at 0–4 °C; reheat to ≥ 75 °C core Sauce: 72 h at 0–4 °C Raw portioned chops: 48 h at 0–4 °C
ae39aa90.al: 7 Milk (cream 20%, milk 3%, butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 10 Mustard (wholegrain mustard) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

90f2f5f8.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 220 g = 2200 g · Portion: 220 g
c: Prep. Pork shoulder 3 cm cubes; onion 1 cm dice; carrots 1 cm rounds; peppers 2 cm; potatoes 2.5 cm; beans 3 cm.
Sear. Season pork; sear in very hot oil in small batches until deeply browned. Transfer to GN 1/1 × 65 mm.
Base. Sweat onion and carrots 5 min; add paprika off the heat 20 s. Add wine, reduce by half; add tomatoes and stock.
Assemble. Combine pork, sauce, peppers, potatoes and beans; liquid three quarters up the meat. Cover.
Braise. Combi 160 °C, 30 % humidity, 75–90 min until fork-tender. Core ≥ 75 °C; adjust salt.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; parsley on top. Replace with a fresh half GN. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
90f2f5f8.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

e9b53992.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 150 g = 1500 g · Portion: 150 g
c: Sear. Sear the pork in batches in a hot rondeau until coloured on all sides.
Onion. Return all the meat, add the onion and cook 10 min until soft and golden.
Wine. Deglaze with the wine and reduce by half. Off the heat stir in the paprika.
Braise. Add tomato, savory and pepper; cover and braise at 160 °C for 60 min.
Vegetables. Sauté mushrooms and peppers separately on high heat; fold in for the final 15 min so they keep their shape.
Finish. Season with the salt; finish with garlic and parsley. ≥ 75 °C core.
Hold. GN 1/1 (or clay pots), ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
e9b53992.st: Raw diced pork: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Cooked: blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core.

452f26c2.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 170 g = 1700 g · Portion: 170 g
c: Prep. Trim loin, cut 2 cm medallions (≈ 55 g), flatten lightly. Season with salt and pepper 15 min before cooking.
Sear. Sunflower oil, pan 220–230 °C, 1–1.5 min per side to a deep golden crust.
Roast. GN 1/1 rack, combi 160 °C, 30 % humidity, 6–8 min to 66 °C core; rest 5 min to ≥ 68 °C.
Sauce base. Sweat chopped onion in butter; add crushed green peppercorns, deglaze with white wine, reduce by half.
Sauce. Add beef stock, reduce by one-third; add cream and resting juices, simmer 5 min; thicken to nappe with slaked corn starch.
Finish. Shingle medallions in GN 1/2, sauce at the side. Portion: pork 110 g, sauce 60 g.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; fresh half GN to replenish. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat ≥ 75 °C.
452f26c2.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.
452f26c2.al: 7 Milk (butter, cream 20%) · 9 Celery (beef stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

a267e042.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 260 g = 2600 g · Portion: 260 g
c: Marinate. Rub the pork with oil, garlic, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper; 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast. Roast whole at 160 °C combi (30 % humidity) to ≥ 75 °C core (≈ 100 min). Rest 10 min, slice 1 cm.
Vegetables. Peel and cut into 3 cm batons/wedges; toss with oil, thyme and salt; roast at 200 °C convection 30–35 min, turning once.
Jus. Deglaze the roasting tray with the wine, reduce by half; add stock, simmer 10 min, strain, reduce to 300 g; thicken lightly with cornflour slaked in cold water.
Service. Root vegetables in a GN 1/1, pork slices on top, jus over. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
a267e042.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
a267e042.al: 9 Celery (celeriac, beef stock – check label) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

81563096.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 160 g = 1600 g · Portion: 160 g
c: Prep. Trim loin; cut 110 g escalopes. Flatten to 5 mm between film; nick edges. Cut lemon wedges.
Pané. Season with salt and pepper; flour, egg, breadcrumbs, pressing lightly. Coat max 30 min ahead; keep ≤ 5 °C.
Fry. Oil 1.5–2 cm deep at 170 °C; 2–3 min per side, swirling, until golden. ≥ 68 °C core.
Drain. Single layer on a wire rack; season lightly. Skim crumbs between batches.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C under heat lamp, uncovered, with lemon wedges, max 30 min; fry small batches every 20–30 min.
81563096.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

c38615ec.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 220 g = 2200 g · Portion: 220 g
c: Marinate. Pork neck 3 cm cubes with sliced onion, oil, paprika, pepper; chill 4–12 h. Salt before grilling.
Skewer. Alternate pork, pepper and onion; 120 g per skewer.
Grill. Hot grill 8–10 min, turning; finish combi 180 °C if needed. Core ≥ 72 °C.
Sauce. Blitz tomatoes, garlic, coriander and chilli; simmer with paste, vinegar, sugar 10 min; season; serve warm or room temp.
Hold. Skewers ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h; sauce in a bowl alongside.
c38615ec.st: Marinated meat 0–4 °C, 24 h. Sauce 0–4 °C, 72 h. Grill in batches for service.

414cdbe1.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 200 g = 2000 g · Portion: 200 g
c: Prep. Trim, cut pork into 4 cm cubes; season with salt and pepper, dry-brine 2–12 h at 0–4 °C. Slice onion 3 mm.
Sear. Pat dry; sear in hot oil (\~200 °C) in single-layer batches 5–6 min until deep brown. Remove.
Base. Sweat onion in the fat 5 min; add tomato paste 2 min, then paprika off the heat 30 s.
Sauerkraut. Rinse if very sour, squeeze dry, chop roughly; stir in. Add hot beef stock and bay leaf, return pork.
Braise. Covered GN 1/1 (65 mm), combi 150–160 °C, 60 % humidity, 90–120 min until fork-tender, ≥ 75 °C core. Remove bay leaf.
Serve. Sauerkraut base in half GN, pork on top; portion 100 g pork, 100 g sauerkraut.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.
414cdbe1.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

90071b1b.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 180 g = 1800 g · Portion: 180 g
c: Cut. Pork neck into 3 cm cubes; 5 pieces per skewer.
Marinate. Oil, lemon, crushed garlic, oregano, paprika and pepper; 4–12 h at 0–4 °C. Salt before grilling.
Tzatziki. Grate cucumber, salt 10 min, squeeze dry; mix with yoghurt, garlic, oil, dill and lemon. Chill.
Grill. Chargrill very hot, turning, 10–12 min to 68 °C core; rest 3 min.
Hold. GN, ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h; grill in batches. Tzatziki on ice ≤ 5 °C beside.

470bada6.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 260 g = 2600 g · Portion: 260 g
c: Season. Rub the beef with garlic, paprika, salt and pepper; sear hard in the oil on all sides.
Base. Brown onion, carrot and celery; add paste 2 min; deglaze with wine and reduce by half.
Braise. Add beef, stock, bay and thyme; cover and braise at 150 °C for 3–3.5 h until it pulls apart, ≥ 75 °C core.
Pull. Lift out the beef, pull into chunks with forks, discard sinew.
Jus. Strain the braising liquor, skim the fat, reduce to 400 g; thicken lightly with the cornflour slaked in cold water. Fold a little jus through the beef.
Vegetables. Zucchini and eggplant 1 cm slices, peppers in quarters, onion in thick rings; toss with oil and salt; chargrill until tender.
Service. Vegetables in a GN 1/1, pulled beef on top, jus over. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
470bada6.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
470bada6.al: 9 Celery (celery stalk, beef stock – check label) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

971931c3.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 260 g = 2600 g · Portion: 260 g
c: Prep. Trim the topside, tie, rub with oil, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Sear. Sear on all sides in a hot roasting tray, 6–8 min.
Roast. Roast at 140 °C combi (20 % humidity) to ≥ 75 °C core (≈ 2 h). Rest 15 min; slice 3 mm against the grain.
Gravy. In the roasting tray brown onion, carrot and celery in oil; add paste and flour, 2 min. Whisk in hot stock, scrape the tray; simmer 15 min, strain, reduce to 500 g. Season.
Onion & tomato. Red onion in 8 wedges, tomatoes halved; toss with oil, thyme and salt; roast at 200 °C convection 15–20 min.
Service. Onion and tomato in a GN 1/1, overlapping beef slices, gravy over or in a boat. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
971931c3.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
971931c3.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 9 Celery (celery stalk, beef stock – check label)

c4ea0531.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 220 g = 2200 g · Portion: 220 g
c: Prep. Trim legs, pat dry. Crush garlic; chop rosemary finely.
Marinate. Mix oil, garlic, rosemary, lemon, paprika, salt and pepper; rub in, under the skin. Chill 2–12 h.
Roast. Skin up on oiled GN 1/1; combi 170 °C, 30 % humidity, 25 min, then hot air 200 °C, 10–15 min.
Core. ≥ 75 °C at the bone, target 80 °C; juices clear.
Finish. Rest 5 min; deglaze trays with water, reduce slightly, baste legs.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h, with juices and rosemary; replace with a fresh half GN. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
c4ea0531.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

c: Marinade. Mix lemon juice, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, paprika, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Marinate. Marinate boneless thighs min. 2 h at max. 5 °C.
Roast. Roast on trays at 200 °C for 20–25 min to a core temperature of 75 °C.
Service. Rest 5 min, slice if large, spoon over pan juices. Hold at min. 63 °C.
b2e3905d.st: Marinated raw: 24 h at 0–4 °C. Cooked: 3 days at 0–4 °C. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max. 2 h.

9a408e29.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 150 g = 1500 g · Portion: 150 g
c: Score. Score skin 1 cm apart, not into the meat. Rub flesh with salt, garlic, thyme, pepper; salt the skin. Chill uncovered overnight.
Roast. Brush off salt; skin up on a rack, combi dry heat 150 °C, ≈ 2 h, to 85 °C core.
Crackle. Pour off fat; 220 °C, full fan, 15–25 min until skin puffs evenly.
Rest. 15 min uncovered; cut skin side down into 3 cm pieces, 120 g portions.
Apple sauce. Apples 2 cm dice; cook covered with sugar, lemon, cinnamon and water 10–12 min. Pulse coarse; 30 g per portion.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C uncovered, max 2 h; sauce alongside. Replace with a fresh half GN.
9a408e29.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

dbe6d2b4.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 200 g = 2000 g · Portion: 200 g
c: Prep. Singe and scrape skin; rinse. Cover with cold water, add onion, carrots, salt, pepper and bay.
Simmer. Bring to boil, skim; bare simmer 2–2½ h until the bone moves easily. Cool 20 min in the liquid.
Season. Score skin, rub with oil, crushed garlic, paprika and salt.
Roast. Combi 180 °C dry 40 min, then 230 °C 10–15 min until skin is crisp and blistered. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Portion. Rest 10 min; cut along the bone into 200 g pieces.
Hold. GN 1/1 uncovered, ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; refill in small batches. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
dbe6d2b4.st: Leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core.

cdca29b0.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 180 g = 1800 g · Portion: 180 g
c: Dry-brine. Trim to 5 mm fat, score in a 1 cm crosshatch; rub with salt, refrigerate uncovered 12–24 h (min. 2 h).
Sear. Rub with oil, crushed garlic, chopped thyme and pepper; tie every 3 cm. Sear at 220 °C until deep golden, 6–8 min.
Roast. Combi 140 °C, 30 % humidity, to 66 °C core (50–70 min). Rest covered 15 min to ≥ 68 °C core.
Jus. Sweat sliced onion in the tray fat 5 min; add sugar and apple wedges, colour lightly, remove apples when tender.
Sauce. Deglaze with white wine, reduce by half; add beef stock, simmer 10 min. Strain, thicken with slaked corn starch to light nappe.
Carve. Remove twine, slice 1 cm against the grain; portion 120 g pork, 20 g apple, 40 g jus.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.
cdca29b0.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

73fa4cdb.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 260 g = 2600 g · Portion: 260 g
c: Marinate. Pork with mustard, oil, garlic, salt and pepper, 12 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast. Roast at 160 °C convection to ≥ 75 °C core (≈ 100 min); for the last 10 min baste with foaming butter and rosemary. Rest 10 min, slice 1 cm.
Eggplant. 2 cm dice, salt 30 min, pat dry, roast with part of the oil at 210 °C 20 min.
Base. Sweat onion, celery and pepper in the remaining oil; add tomatoes, 10 min. Add vinegar and sugar (agrodolce), capers, olives and soaked raisins.
Finish. Fold in the eggplant, simmer 5 min; basil at service.
Service. Caponata warm under or beside the pork. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
73fa4cdb.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
73fa4cdb.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (celery stalk) · 10 Mustard (Dijon) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar, raisins, capers)

c: Prep. Use new foil, clean trays and boards washed just before use. Wash vegetables; leave whole, unpeeled and uncut.
Potato. Scrub, rub with oil and salt, double-wrap in foil; 200 °C, 50–60 min until soft in the centre.
Trout. Rinse, dry, season inside and out; lemon slices, garlic and parsley in the cavity, oil outside. Double-wrap each fish in foil.
Roast. 200 °C, 18–22 min to 63 °C core at the thickest part.
Plating. Each guest: trout and potato in their sealed foil on a large plate; 1 whole tomato and 1 whole cucumber beside. Guests open the foil themselves.
24a908f6.st: Cook to order for the sitting; do not hold cooked fish over 2 h at ≥ 63 °C Raw trout: 0–2 °C, use within 24 h Same menu Sat 10, Sun 11 and Mon 12.10. No butter or dairy. Keep the group's food separate from other orders.

afce46de.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 260 g = 2600 g · Portion: 260 g
c: Prep. Season the turkey with salt and pepper, brush with oil; vacuum-pack or wrap tightly in film.
Slow-cook. Combi steam 82 °C to ≥ 75 °C core (≈ 75–90 min). Rest 10 min; sear briefly for colour if wished; slice 1 cm.
Sauce. Sweat onion, garlic, ginger and grated apple in butter 6 min; add curry powder 1 min, then flour 2 min. Whisk in hot stock; simmer 15 min, add cream, blend smooth; reduce to 500 g. Season.
Cabbage. Shred 5 mm. Sweat onion in oil, add cabbage, caraway, sugar, salt and water; braise covered 25 min; finish with lemon juice.
Service. Cabbage in a GN 1/1, turkey slices on top, sauce over. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
afce46de.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 2 months. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C core. Hot hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.
afce46de.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter, cream) · 9 Celery (chicken stock – check label). Curry powder: check label (may contain 10 Mustard, 9 Celery).

24978291.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 255 g = 2550 g · Portion: 255 g
c: Prep. Portion the fish into 10 × 140 g, pin-boned; season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Steam. Combi steam 85 °C, 8–10 min, to ≥ 63 °C core.
Cauliflower. Steam 100 °C 6–8 min until just tender; toss with butter and salt.
Sauce. Reduce shallot, water and lemon juice to 50 g; add cream, boil 1 min. Off the heat whisk in the cold butter piece by piece; strain, add chopped dill, season. Hold at 60–65 °C (do not boil).
Service. Cauliflower in a GN 1/1, fish on top, sauce over or in a warmed boat. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h.
24978291.st: Raw fish: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Cooked fish and cauliflower: blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min, 0–4 °C, 48 h. Butter sauce: make fresh, do not store.

1f06fa04.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 190 g = 1900 g · Portion: 190 g
c: Prep. Cut the turkey 3 cm, season with salt. Dice onion and carrots 8 mm; quarter mushrooms. Heat the water with the bay leaf.
Sweat. Sweat onion and carrot in butter at ≈ 140 °C 4–5 min, no colour. Add turkey; seal 5 min, still white.
Sauce. Dust with flour, cook 2 min; add the hot water gradually. Cover, simmer 20 min; add mushrooms for the last 10 min and peas for the last 4 min.
Finish. Add cream; simmer 2 min to nappe. Remove bay; add lemon juice, season. Turkey ≥ 75 °C core.

Flake poached and smoked trout coarsely; remove all pin bones.
Beat soft butter with yoghurt, lemon juice and zest; fold in fish, chopped dill and chives. Season, chill 2 h to set.
Slice rye 5 mm, cut 50 “tombstones” 8 × 4 cm with a rounded top; brush with oil, salt lightly.
Bake at 150 °C, 12–15 min, until crisp. Blitz the trimmings, toast 5 min = “soil”.
Small button mushrooms (2–3 cm caps), brushed clean; halve lengthwise through the stem so they keep the mushroom shape.
Sear cut side down in hot oil, 3–4 min, until golden; add garlic and thyme for 1 min, then lemon juice and salt.
Cool on a tray, chill to 4 °C.
Beat cold cream cheese with lemon and salt until smooth and stiff; piping bag with a 1.5 cm plain nozzle, keep at 0–4 °C.
Ghost: pipe a 3 cm mound straight down, lift slowly and finish with a curled tip (≈ 10 g each, 50 pcs).
Eyes and mouth: tiny pieces of black olive.
Spread rillettes on 5 boards ≈ 440 g in a long bed; scatter rye soil on top.
Stand 10 tombstones upright in each bed; mushrooms in small clusters between them, cut side down, as if growing from the soil.
Pipe 10 ghosts on top of each bed between the tombstones; cucumber ribbons and dill sprigs as “grass”.
Out of the fridge max 2 h; tombstones go in last so they stay crisp.
75ad3236.st: Rillettes, mushrooms, cream cheese: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Tombstones: airtight, room temperature, 3 days. Pipe ghosts max 1 h before service.
75ad3236.al: 1 Gluten (rye bread) · 4 Fish (smoked salmon trout, salmon trout fillet) · 7 Milk (strained yoghurt, butter, cream cheese)

606ef9a6.yl: Yield: 50 cake pops · Portion: 1 pop ≈ 34 g
c: Batch · Batter ≈ 1040 g · Yield ≈ 900 g baked
Whisk all as for the cupcakes; bake in a lined 30 × 40 cm tray at 170 °C convection, 18–20 min. Cool completely.
Rub sponge to fine crumbs; beat butter and icing sugar, mix in to a firm paste. Roll 50 balls × 25 g; chill 30 min.
Melt white chocolate with ⅔ of the oil; colour ⅔ orange (pumpkins) and keep ⅓ white (ghosts). Melt dark chocolate with the rest (spider webs).
Dip a stick 1 cm in chocolate, push halfway into each ball; set 10 min. Dip each pop, tap off the excess, stand in a polystyrene block.
Pumpkins: dark chocolate face. Ghosts: dark eyes and mouth. Webs (dark pops): white chocolate rings, dragged into a web.
Serve on a round platter with spider and mummy cookies around the pops.
606ef9a6.st: Cake pops: 0–4 °C, 3 days, out 30 min before service. Sticks: paper lollipop sticks only.
606ef9a6.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (white chocolate, dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, white chocolate). Chocolate, candy eyes and sprinkles: check labels (soy, milk traces, nuts).

d26385b5.yl: Yield: 50 paper cones · Portion: 1 cone ≈ 30 g
c: Pop in batches in a popcorn machine or a covered pot with the oil; discard unpopped kernels.
Work in 3 batches (orange, green, purple): ⅓ of the sugar, water, butter and glucose to 120 °C.
Off the heat stir in the gel colour, salt and soda (it foams); pour over ⅓ of the popcorn, toss quickly.
Spread on lined trays; dry at 110 °C, 15 min, stirring once. Cool, break up, mix the colours.
30 g per paper cone just before service.

2c15b70f.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 120 g = 1200 g · Portion: 120 g
c: Cut. Scrub potatoes; cut into 8 wedges. Keep 10 medium potatoes as halves for the lantern faces.
Par-boil. Salted water 5 min; drain and steam-dry 5 min.
Season. Toss with oil, smoked paprika, crushed garlic, salt and pepper.
Roast. 210 °C 30–35 min in a single layer; turn once, until crisp.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, uncovered, max 30 min; parsley on top.
Faces. Take the 10 reserved potato halves. On the cut side carve a jack-o’-lantern face 3 mm deep with a paring knife: 2 triangle eyes, a triangle nose, a zigzag mouth.
Roast. Roast the faces cut side up with the wedges; the paprika oil darkens the grooves so the face shows.
Display. Wedges in a dark pan. Set the face halves on top, facing the guest.
Finish. Chopped parsley only on the wedges, not on the faces.
Refill. Carve 5 new faces for every refill so every pan has lanterns.
2c15b70f.st: Roast in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

156fa724.yl: Yield: 50 portions (5 sharing bowls) · Portion: 90 g
c: Butterfly breasts to an even 2 cm, season, oil; char-grill 3–4 min per side, finish at 180 °C to 74 °C core; chill, slice 1 cm.
Blend anchovy, garlic, mustard and lemon to a paste; whisk in mayonnaise, finely grated parmesan and water to a coating consistency.
Peeled pumpkin in 1.5 cm cubes; toss with oil, salt and paprika, one layer on lined trays.
Roast at 210 °C convection, 18–20 min, until caramelised at the edges but holding shape; cool on the tray, chill.
Crustless bread in 1.5 cm cubes, toss with oil and salt; bake at 170 °C, 10–12 min, until golden and dry.
Romaine in 4 cm pieces, washed and spun dry; keep at 0–4 °C.
At service: toss romaine and half the pumpkin with ⅔ of the dressing; 5 bowls ≈ 930 g.
Top with chicken, the rest of the pumpkin, rest of the dressing, croutons, parmesan shavings and pumpkin seeds.
156fa724.st: Grilled chicken, roasted pumpkin and dressing: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Dressed salad: serve within 1 h.
156fa724.al: 1 Gluten (white bread) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (anchovy fillets) · 7 Milk (parmesan) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard). Mayonnaise: check label (mustard).

51926a4e.yl: Yield: 50 mini burgers · Portion: 1 burger ≈ 100 g (patty 40 · bun 35 · cheese, sauce & eyes 25)
c: Grate onion finely and squeeze; mix with cold mince, egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper, max 2 min.
Shape 50 patties × 50 g, 7 cm wide; chill 30 min on paper.
Griddle 2–3 min per side to 75 °C core.
Teeth: cheddar slices 6 × 6 cm, one edge cut in a zigzag (5 teeth, 8 mm deep). Lay on the hot patty, teeth over the front; 30 s in the oven.
Split buns, toast cut sides 1 min. Build: base, ketchup, lettuce frills out at the back as hair, patty with cheese, lid.
Eyes: mozzarella balls 1.5 cm, halved, olive slice as pupil; fix 2 on each lid with a dot of mayonnaise. Ketchup dot between the teeth as tongue.
Assemble in batches of 20; low tray at child height, faces to the front. No cocktail sticks. Serve within 30 min.
51926a4e.st: Raw patties: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Grilled: blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Assembled: serve within 30 min.
51926a4e.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, mini brioche buns) · 3 Eggs (eggs, mini brioche buns, mayonnaise) · 7 Milk (mini brioche buns, cheddar, mozzarella) · 11 Sesame (mini brioche buns). Check labels: buns (soy, nuts), mayonnaise (mustard).

e3cb92af.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 100 g = 1000 g · Portion: 100 g
c: Grill. Flatten chicken to 1.5 cm, oil and season; grill 3–4 min per side to 74 °C core. Rest, chill, slice 1 cm strips.
Dressing. Whisk mustard, lemon juice, honey, salt and pepper; stream in oil.
Salad. Romaine in 3 cm pieces, cucumber in half-moons; keep both dry and chilled.
Guacamole. Mash avocado with lime juice, grated garlic and salt; leave slightly coarse. Film on the surface, max 2 h.
Toss. Per platter (10 portions) toss leaves, cucumber and chicken with dressing just before decorating.
Platter. Round black slate or dark bowl, Ø 35–40 cm, 10 portions each. Make one at a time; replace the platter, do not top up.
Face. Pile the tossed salad into a dome. Spread guacamole over the front two thirds with a palette knife: a rough oval face, edges uneven.
Teeth. Tortillas cut with scissors into 1.5 cm zigzag strips, baked 180 °C 5–6 min until crisp. Push a row into the lower edge of the guacamole as a grin.
Eyes. 2 mozzarella balls, halved, cut side out; a slice of black olive as pupil, held with a dot of guacamole. Uneven sizes look more monster-like.
Hair. Spring onion tops cut in 6 cm strips, set in iced water 10 min to curl; stand them along the top as hair and two short pieces as eyebrows.
e3cb92af.st: Components 0–4 °C, 24 h. Decorated platter max 2 h on the buffet, then discard.

c0f1bd9c.yl: Yield: 50 cookies (≈ 6 cm) · Portion: 1 cookie ≈ 34 g
c: Batch · Dough ≈ 1020 g · Yield ≈ 950 g baked
Cream butter and icing sugar 2 min, add egg and vanilla, then flour and salt; flatten, chill 1 h.
Roll 5 mm between paper; cut 6 cm rounds. Bake at 160 °C convection, 10–12 min, light golden. Cool.
Colour 150 g fondant red (monsters); keep 500 g white (mummies). Glue: icing sugar + water to a thick paste.
Mummies (35): roll white fondant 2 mm, cut 6–8 mm strips; brush cookie with glue, lay strips crossing, trim at the edge.
Monsters (15): red fondant round on the cookie, white strip mouth.
2 candy eyes per cookie, peeping between the bandages. Dry 1 h before stacking.
c0f1bd9c.st: Decorated cookies: airtight, room temperature, 3 days. Never chill (fondant sweats).
c0f1bd9c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (candy eyes) · 7 Milk (butter). Chocolate, candy eyes and sprinkles: check labels (soy, milk traces, nuts).

59231f5d.yl: Yield: 50 portions (100 mummies) · Portion: 2 mummies ≈ 120 g + 20 g ketchup
c: Frankfurters 45 g, ≈ 12 cm: pat dry so the pastry sticks; keep at 0–4 °C.
Roll puff pastry 2 mm, chill 10 min; cut 5 mm strips with a pizza wheel.
Wrap the head with one strip, leave a 1.5 cm face gap 1 cm below the top, then 2–3 strips crossing over the body; tuck the ends under. Chill 15 min.
Egg wash the pastry only, not the face. Bake on lined trays at 200 °C, 15–18 min, until deep golden; ≥ 75 °C core.
Eyes: pipe 2 dots of mild mustard in each face gap; press a tiny olive piece into each as a pupil.
Black slate, mummies in rows, some leaning on each other; ketchup in small black bowls, a few drips on the slate.
Bake in waves of one tray; hold ≥ 63 °C, max 45 min.
59231f5d.st: Wrapped raw mummies: 0–4 °C, 24 h, covered. Baked: hold ≥ 63 °C, max 45 min, do not reheat.
59231f5d.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (puff pastry) · 10 Mustard (mustard). Check frankfurter and ketchup labels (gluten, milk, soy, mustard, sulphites).

060a8133.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 100 g = 1000 g · Portion: 100 g
c: Cut. Peel or keep skin on, deseed; cut 3 cm wedges.
Season. Toss with oil, garlic, thyme, honey, salt and pepper.
Roast. 200 °C 25–30 min until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Sage. Fry dry sage leaves in oil at 170 °C 10–15 s until they stop bubbling; drain on paper, 0.5 g salt.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 45 min; sage and seeds on at service.
Bowl. Dark round dish. Wedges stacked in overlapping rings, skin side out, like a pumpkin's ribs.
Sage. Crisp sage leaves on top in a small cluster, like the leaves at a pumpkin's stalk.
Seeds. Toasted pumpkin seeds scattered over.
Garnish. A small decorative pumpkin or gourd at the side of the dish (washed, for show only, labelled not for eating).
Refill. Add sage and seeds fresh on each refill so they stay crisp.
060a8133.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core. Crisp sage: dry container, same day.

962e3c65.yl: Yield: 50 portions · Portion: 180 g (pasta 80 · sauce 55 · 2 meatballs with eyes 45)
c: Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg, grated parmesan, garlic, chopped parsley, salt and pepper briefly; chill 20 min.
Roll 100 balls × 25 g; bake on oiled trays at 200 °C, 10–12 min, to 75 °C core.
Sweat sliced garlic in oil 1 min, no colour; add tomatoes, passata, sugar, salt and pepper.
Simmer 25 min, stirring; tear in basil. Add the meatballs for the last 10 min.
Eyes: mozzarella sliced 5 mm, punch 1.5 cm discs; olive slices punched to 6 mm pupils.
Boil spaghetti in salted water (10 L per kg, 10 g salt per L) 1 min under packet time, ≈ 8 min; drain, keep 500 ml water (≈ 4000 g cooked).
Toss pasta with sauce in batches of 10 portions; loosen with cooking water.
Dark gratin dish, spaghetti loose and messy, meatballs half-buried; a mozzarella disc on each, pupil off-centre; 1 min under the salamander to stick.
A few strands hanging over the rim like escaping worms; basil at the edges. Hold ≥ 63 °C, max 30 min per batch.
962e3c65.st: Sauce and meatballs: 0–4 °C, 72 h; reheat to ≥ 75 °C. Tossed pasta: hold ≥ 63 °C, max 30 min.

1daa53df.yl: Yield: 50 cookies (≈ 6 cm) · Portion: 1 cookie ≈ 28 g
c: Cream butter and icing sugar, add egg and vanilla, then flour and salt; chill 1 h.
Same method with cocoa sifted into the flour; chill 1 h.
Roll plain dough 5 mm, cut 6 cm rounds. Roll 6 g cocoa balls, press one in the centre of each cookie.
Bake at 160 °C convection, 11–13 min. Cool completely.
Melt chocolate to 45 °C, cool to 31 °C; pipe 8 bent legs from the body with a fine cornet.
2 candy eyes on the body while the chocolate is soft. Set at 18 °C, 20 min.
1daa53df.st: Baked cookies: airtight, room temperature, 5 days. Keep away from heat (chocolate legs).
1daa53df.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%, candy eyes) · 7 Milk (butter). Chocolate, candy eyes and sprinkles: check labels (soy, milk traces, nuts).

c3c7c7e6.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 100 g = 1000 g · Portion: 100 g
c: Prep. Skin the smoked trout, flake into 3 cm pieces. Fennel shaved 1 mm on a mandoline into lemon water; drain well.
Ribbons. Peel cucumber into long ribbons with a peeler, stop at the seeds; pat dry.
Cream. Grate horseradish finely; mix with yoghurt, lemon juice, oil, chopped dill, salt and pepper. Chill 30 min.
Build. Per platter: leaves, then fennel and cucumber ribbons in loose folds, trout on top; keep 0–4 °C.
Platter. White or light grey oval platter, so the black spiders stand out; 10 portions each.
Web. Put the horseradish cream in a piping bag, 3 mm nozzle. Pipe 4 concentric circles on top of the salad, then drag a skewer from the centre outward 8 times to make the web.
Spiders. 1 olive per spider: halve lengthways. One half, cut side down = body. Cut the other half crosswise into 8 thin slivers = legs, 4 per side.
Place. 3 spiders per platter: one in the web centre, two climbing at the rim. A short line of cream as the thread from the web edge.
Finish. Small dill sprigs around the rim like moss. Serve the rest of the cream in a small bowl on the side.
c3c7c7e6.st: Components 0–4 °C, 24 h. Decorated platter max 2 h on the buffet, then discard. Fresh grated horseradish only; jarred creamed horseradish may contain egg, mustard or sulphites.

5ef6eabe.yl: Yield: 50 squares (GN 1/1 tray, 10 × 5) · Portion: 1 square ≈ 50 g
c: Batch · Batter ≈ 2950 g · Yield ≈ 2400 g baked
Melt chocolate and butter at 45 °C. Whisk eggs, sugar and vanilla 3 min (not foamy); stir in the chocolate.
Fold in sifted flour, cocoa and salt. Lined GN 1/1 (53 × 32 cm).
Bake at 165 °C convection, 22–25 min: set edges, slightly soft centre. Cool, chill 2 h before cutting.
Cut 10 × 5 squares with a hot knife.
Pipe 3 white chocolate rings on each square; drag a cocktail stick from the centre out 6–8 times = web.
Optional: a small dark chocolate spider on a few squares.
5ef6eabe.st: Airtight, room temperature, 4 days; −18 °C, 1 month uncut.
5ef6eabe.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%, white chocolate) · 7 Milk (butter, white chocolate). Chocolate, candy eyes and sprinkles: check labels (soy, milk traces, nuts).

fc1ef3ec.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 165 g = 1650 g · Portion: 165 g
c: SWAMP: HERB OIL, LILY PADS, REEDS
Prep. Pin-bone, trim, portion 140 g. Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice 10 min before baking.
Crust. Blitz breadcrumbs, soft butter, parsley, dill, spring onion, garlic, lemon zest and salt to a bright green paste.
Coat. Spread 3 mm crust on each portion; chill 10 min to set.
Bake. 180 °C 10–12 min to 60 °C core; 1 min under the salamander until the crust just crisps (keep it green).
Herb oil. Blanch parsley 10 s, refresh, squeeze; blend with oil and salt 2 min. Strain through cloth.
Hold. ≥ 63 °C, max 30 min per tray; bake in waves.
Swamp. Pour herb oil over a dark rectangular platter or hot tray, in an uneven pool, like swamp water.
Fish. Lay portions in the swamp in 2 slightly crooked rows, crust up, gaps between them.
Lily pads. Lemon slices 3 mm, cut a small V out of each. Lay half-sunk between the fish, 1 per portion.
Reeds. Long dill sprigs stuck upright between the portions and at the platter edges.
Refresh. Wipe the platter rim and add fresh oil with each new tray.
fc1ef3ec.st: Cook in batches for service; leftovers blast-chill, 0–4 °C, 24 h. Reheat once to ≥ 75 °C.

c: Batch · Dough ≈ 1020 g (20 g each) · Yield ≈ 950 g baked
Rub cold diced butter into flour, icing sugar, baking powder and salt; add egg and vanilla, bring together. Do not knead. Chill 30 min.
Roll 20 g pieces into 9–10 cm fingers, slightly thinner in the middle; pinch 2 knuckles, mark wrinkles with a knife back.
Press a blanched almond firmly on the tip as the nail. Chill 15 min on lined trays.
Bake at 160 °C convection, 12–14 min, pale golden. Cool on the tray.
Lift each almond, pipe a dot of jam under it and press back: the jam bleeds at the nail bed.
A little jam at the cut end of some fingers. Serve on a dark board, fingers piled at angles.
a78a7464.st: Raw dough: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Baked fingers: airtight, room temperature, 5 days.
a78a7464.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds). Contains nuts (almonds): label clearly at the kids' corner.

c: Batch · Batter ≈ 2510 g (50 g per cup) · Yield ≈ 2250 g baked
Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda and salt with sugar; whisk eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; combine just until smooth.
Black or orange cases in muffin trays, 50 g batter each; bake at 165 °C convection, 18–20 min, skewer clean. Cool.
Beat soft butter 5 min until pale; add icing sugar gradually, then milk, vanilla and orange gel. Beat 3 min.
Cone: boil cream, pour on chopped chocolate, stir smooth; cool to a stiff ganache. Pipe 50 cones 3 cm tall on paper; chill 30 min.
Brim: twist the biscuits apart; use 50 halves (filling side down).
Pipe a 30 g buttercream swirl on each cupcake (1M star nozzle).
Brim on top, cone on the brim, a ring of buttercream at the base as the hat band; silver pearls.
74d72f50.st: Baked cupcakes: covered, room temperature, 24 h. Decorated: cool room 16–18 °C, serve the same day.
74d72f50.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, cocoa sandwich biscuits) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%, cocoa sandwich biscuits) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, cream 33%). Chocolate, candy eyes and sprinkles: check labels (soy, milk traces, nuts).

e2359dec.yl: Yield: 50 brooms (5 platters × 10) · Portion: 1 broom ≈ 60 g
c: Top beans; blanch 3 min in boiling salted water, refresh in iced water, dry.
Carrot batons 12 cm × 1 cm = handles; blanch 2 min.
Bundle 8–10 beans around one end of each handle; wrap tightly with 1 bacon rasher, seam down.
Brush with garlic oil, pepper; roast at 200 °C, 12–15 min, until bacon is crisp.
Tie a blanched chive around the bacon; 5 platters, 10 brooms each.
e2359dec.st: Raw wrapped brooms: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Roasted: serve within 30 min.

Sweat onion, carrot, garlic and ginger in butter and oil, 10 min, no colour; add pumpkin and water, simmer 20 min.
Blend very smooth, pass through a fine sieve; add cream, bring back to the boil, season.
Warm oil to 80 °C with sage, 5 min; blend, rest 1 h, strain.
Toast seeds in a dry pan until they pop, 3–4 min; season with paprika and salt.
Soup ≥ 75 °C into 5 hot tureens (or hollowed pumpkins from the carving) ≈ 2060 g.
Swirl of sage oil on top; seeds in a small bowl next to each tureen.

c: Soak fruit in hot water 15 min; drain; chop half. Sweat onion in butter; mix with chopped fruit, crumbs and thyme.
Butterfly the loin into a flat sheet 2 cm thick; season; spread stuffing, line whole fruits along the centre; roll and tie at 3 cm intervals.
Sear all over; roast 160 °C to core 68 °C (about 1 h 15 min); rest 15 min (carry-over to 70 °C).
Deglaze the tray with cider; reduce by half; add stock; reduce to 400 ml; thicken lightly; whisk in mustard and butter.
001e910c.st: Cooked, chilled < 5 °C in 90 min: 0–3 °C 72 h. Slice cold; reheat covered with jus to ≥ 75 °C.

Sear fat-side down until deep brown; set aside. Cook sliced onions in the fat 20 min until soft and golden; add garlic and tomato paste.
Add beer, stock, sugar, bay and thyme; return brisket; cover tightly; braise 150 °C 3 h 30 min – 4 h until fork-tender (core ~92 °C).
Rest 30 min; slice across the grain 1 cm. Reduce the liquid with mustard to a sauce.
3 slices with onion sauce; mash or roast potatoes.
c9f6252e.st: Cook-chill whole in the liquid: 0–3 °C 4 days. Slice cold; reheat in sauce to ≥ 75 °C. Freezes −18 °C 3 months.

c: Cut thighs across the bone into 5 cm pieces (butcher's saw); season, flour and brown.
Sweat the diced vegetables; add garlic and wine; reduce by half.
Add tomatoes, stock, bay and turkey; braise covered 160 °C 1 h 30 min until tender. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Chop together finely; scatter at service.
2 pieces with sauce on risotto or soft polenta.
d9a248cd.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 9 Celery (celery, chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (dry white wine). Contains gluten, celery, sulphites.

c: Blend crumbs, herbs, zest and garlic until green; add soft butter and Parmesan; roll between paper 3 mm; chill; cut to fillet size.
Portion 160 g; season; lay crust on top; bake on oiled trays 200 °C 9–11 min to core 60 °C.
Sweat shallots in oil; add peeled, seeded, diced tomatoes and thyme; cook 15 min to a soft compote.
Fish on 80 g fondue; lemon butter optional.
9123bfc8.st: Crust sheets frozen −18 °C 1 month. Fish cooked in batches; hold ≥ 63 °C max 45 min.

Sweat onion and carrots (thick batons) 6 min; add garlic, orange zest, star anise, thyme, wine; reduce.
Add stock, orange juice and honey; lay legs skin up, liquid below the skin; braise uncovered 160 °C 1 h 45 min. Core ≥ 75 °C.
Skim fat; reduce liquid to 500 ml; lightly thicken; mount with butter.
One leg on carrots with 50 ml sauce; crisp the skin under the salamander.
060d7f87.st: Cook-chill 0–3 °C 4 days. Reheat skin-up 200 °C 15 min to ≥ 75 °C.

Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter until golden; add shallots and garlic 3 min; tomato paste 1 min.
Flame with brandy; add wine, reduce by half; add demi-glace and diced tomatoes.
Return chicken; simmer covered 20 min to core ≥ 75 °C. Finish with herbs.
2 thighs with sauce; buttered noodles or mash.
5991aef9.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (demi-glace) · 14 Sulphites (brandy, dry white wine). Contains milk, celery, sulphites.

Sear seam-side first; roast 180 °C to core 63 °C (12–15 min); rest 8 min (66 °C).
Sweat shallots in the pan; deglaze with Marsala; reduce by half; add stock; reduce to 300 ml; mount with cold butter.

Slice potatoes 3 mm and onions thinly; layer in a deep roasting tray with thyme; pour stock to just below the top; dot with butter.
Sit the lamb on a rack over the potatoes; roast 220 °C 30 min, then 150 °C 3 h 30 min until the meat pulls from the bone; the fat bastes the potatoes.
Rest 20 min; pull the meat into large pieces. Core ≥ 75 °C.
180 g lamb on 240 g potatoes with the juices.
37622420.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (lamb stock). Contains milk, celery.

Trim into 2 even pieces; season; dry well.
Lay crêpes on rolled pastry (barrier), then duxelles, spinach, dill and salmon; wrap; seal seam down; chill 30 min.
Brush with yolk; score; bake 210 °C 15 min, then 190 °C 15–20 min to core 50–52 °C (fish rests to 55 °C). Rest 10 min.
250 g slice with beurre blanc or dill hollandaise.
00521a76.st: Assembled raw 0–3 °C 24 h. Serve within 2 h of baking.
